record.question: Under the Employment Exchanges (Compulsory Notification of Vacancies) Act, 1959 - If any person required to furnish information or return refuse or neglected to do the same, he may be punish with a fine of
options: two hundred which may extend to five hundred rupees
two hundred which may extend to three hundred rupees
two hundred and fifty rupees which may extend to three hundred rupees
two hundred and fifty rupees which may extend to five hundred rupees
record.explanation: Failure to furnish information attracts a fine of Rs. 200 extendable to Rs. 500.
